children: Inventories of ethanol in the U.S. for the week ended Sep. 4 landed on the high side of analyst forecasts, this while average ethanol production fell from the prior week.

The Energy Information Administration's latest weekly report Wednesday said ethanol inventories totaled 25.19 million barrels for the week. It's 152,000 barrels higher than the previous week, and on the high end of forecasts from analysts surveyed by Dow Jones this week. Those analysts anticipated stocks to land anywhere from 24 million barrels to 25.24 million barrels.

Average daily production for the week fell 11,000 barrels a day, to 1.099 million barrels a day. That's within analyst forecasts for the week, with surveyed analysts forecasting production between 1.085 million barrels and 1.11 million barrels.
CBOT corn futures are up 1% in trading after the report's release. Grain traders are waiting for Friday's WASDE report from the USDA to provide news to trade on.
